comment: The history map (Purify 1.9): Natural Earth land at 1:50m, public domain, as packaged by world-atlas 2.0.2 (ISC, Mike Bostock), cut to longitude -172 to 50 and latitude 25 to 64, equirectangular scaled for latitude 37 at the 1.8 map's scale, simplified within 0.4 of a unit (scripts/maps/build-history-outline.mjs). Widened in 1.9 so Alaska and America stand where they are. lib/history/map.ts places an event by the same sums.
